concerns.text: The Constitution (VI) requires resampling of Raman spectra, but the Feature Specification explicitly excludes Raman spectra (Key Entities section: “Raman spectra are excluded due to limited coverage in the NIST WebBook”). This creates a direct contradiction about whether Raman data is part of the pipeline.

FR-001 ends with a cross‑reference “(See US-1)”, but no User Story or identifier named US-1 is defined anywhere in the document. The same undefined reference appears in many other FRs (e.g., FR-002, FR-003, …). These dangling references violate identifier reuse and should be replaced with the correct User Story IDs (e.g., US-1 → User Story 1) or removed.
